name: OAuth 2.0
short_description: An open authorization standard that decides what an app can reach on a user's behalf using scoped access tokens; it is not a login system on its own, which is why OpenID Connect adds sign-in on top.

evidence.quote: OAuth is about access, meaning it decides what an app can reach on your behalf.
OAuth two point oh is the valid key. It's the reason you can sign into a brand new app with your Microsoft account
OAuth two point oh handles what you're allowed to do
All connectors use OAuth 2.0 for authentication.
It works with standard protocols like OAuth 2.0, open ID connect and SAML.
